text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Good morrrr-ning☆ 
Care to join Falco in the parade~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're the girl who's been racing 
since last year☆ I remember 
your wonderful live concert! This is our 
chance to show our fans even more 
gratitude♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Grand Appreciation Festival's 
"Dreamy Night Parade"... 
Let's do it together with Falco☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A sparkling, glittering parade to show our 
thanks to all the fans! 
Care to try it out with Falco~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Parade... Ah, from the Appreciation 
Festival, maybe? Let's check the school 
event page... 
...Oh, found it. "Regarding the Dreamy 
Night Parade."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"This year, following the athletic 
program, a parade event is planned in the 
special area stretching from the grounds 
to the stage."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"There will be a marching band parade 
alongside illuminations freely designed by 
the students themselves. Those wishing to 
participate—" ...?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing, Tran-san! It says the 
lighting can be customized however we 
want! 
With this, we can set up effects with 
maximum good-luck power!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Rickey-chan. 
Looks like your switch just got flipped.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course it did! No time to waste! 
Faaaaaaaalco-saaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
At times like this, you can always count 
on our academy to go totally wild~ 
And with Rickey-chan's free-spiritedness, 
even more so...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, the best way to enjoy fun stuff is 
from the front-row seat. 
Guess I'll hop on board too~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So this is the parade team's HQ! 
It really is roomy enough for a big crowd!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The vocal lesson room is spacious and has 
great soundproofing, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm so happy both of you joined at 
the same time! 
Rickey-chan, you're interested in the 
stage production side too, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! I want to make all the fans 
super-duper happy with the magic of 
lighting!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The event area is huge if you include the 
path all the way to the stage, right? 
Maybe we could illuminate all eight 
cardinal directions with lucky colors!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aaas expected of Rickey-chan, your ideas 
are bold right from the get-go~ 
Events gotta be thrilling like this, 
otherwise where's the fun?♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to show everyone a view they'll 
never forget too♪ 
And for that parade... Ta-daah☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you're doing the baton, Falco-san! 
A drum major... was it? I've seen them 
spin it around!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Yup♪ What do you think, what do you 
think? 
Even in the parade, I want to show 
everyone Falco leading the way—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Is this the damn room for the parade 
team?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Put me on the team! 
And also—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Let me play this! I want something flashy 
that stands out! 
So I'm playin' the trumpet! No question!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, oi! Is this everyone we got?! 
Four people ain't gonna make a damn 
parade!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it can't be helped~ The event was 
only announced last weekend. 
Still, for a marching band... you're gonna 
need quite a few heads."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Yup! 
So for a while, we'll have to work hard on 
recruiting members!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Bring it on. 
If we can't start without the numbers... 
I'll get it done!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much~. 
...Phew, so much paperwork. Once I get 
back, I need to hurry and revise—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa☆ 
S-Sooorry, are you okay?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I'm perfectly fine. 
Ah, the papers... I'm so sorry! I'll pick 
them up right away!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...The Thanksgiving Parade 
illumination... 
So you're taking part in this, Falco-san."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Yup! We just started choosing songs and 
gathering members. The girls 
who joined are super motivated too! Though 
we still need a lot more people~."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Wow, that sounds so fun! Members... 
gathering members, huh. 
Given the scale of this project, you 
really would need quite a few..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Um! 
May I ask you a little more about this?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, 
here is our highly anticipated top rookie, 
Buena-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Pleased to meet you all♪ 
Also, I reached out to some friends, so—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I think I can help out a bit with 
recruitment too. 
Some girls have already gotten back to me 
with a yes."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh~, as expected of Tier 1 friend-maker. 
Feels like you just short-cutted the early 
game quests all in one go."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Mm-hmm! With this, we can start our 
ensemble practice early! 
Alright, Falco's gonna give the 
choreography her all too~☆"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Heh, leave it to me. 
I'll nail it and look cool doing it!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Could you take the lead on brainstorming 
the staging ideas, Rickey-chan? 
If you get stuck, Falco's here to help 
consult♪"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Yup! Let's pack it full of ideas that 
bring happiness to everyone! 
Tran-sa~n! Let's brainstorm ideas 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Alright! Team 'Dreamy Night Parade', 
is officially launching! Let's make it a 
success, fight on☆"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, today let's focus heavily on the 
canon section♪ 
Even if you can do it individually, 
whether we can sync up is what counts."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Since then, Rickey-san's stage planning 
seems to be progressing, and 
section practice started ahead of 
schedule, so it's smooth sailing—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Gaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: We... we're totally out of sync!
